_comment: What a client tells the house about the screen it is on, and the table each shipped client sends. It rides `prompt.submit` as `params.surface`; the adapter records it per session and strips it (aura-adapter/aura_adapter/surface.py), and hermes/plugins/aura-artifacts reads it back to narrow surfaces.REGISTRY, put one line in the system prompt and pick the session an `artifact_send` lands on. `fields` are the keys of the report and of the plugin's Surface dataclass — the same names on purpose, so the merge is a lookup. A client may only take capabilities away from the registry row for its name, never add them (surfaces.surface_for). Four readers hold to this: hermes/plugins/aura-artifacts/tests/test_surfaces.py (REGISTRY == surfaces), aura-web/src/lib/hermes/surface.test.ts (the web's table), android-app/tools/surface_report_test.py (the phone's), aura-desktop/tests/test_console_state.py (the TUI's).
